info.name: DriveSync - Member 3 (Payment & Fleet)
info.description: Payment Service (5004) and Fleet Management Service (5005). First set adminToken, customerToken and customerId (npm run token -- Admin). Run each folder top-to-bottom: created ids are saved automatically. To test through the API Gateway, change paymentUrl/fleetUrl to http://localhost:5000/api/payments and http://localhost:5000/api/fleet.
